title: Unary polynomial output
statement: For every $C,e\in\mathbb{N}$, there exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every input $x$, $M$ outputs a string of $C(|x|+1)^e$ true bits within $c(|x|+1)^{e+1}$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: C and e are natural numbers
a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine and natural constant exist
output consists of C(|x|+1)^e true bits
replaced:
For all constants $C$ and $e$ there exist a finite Turing machine $M$ and a
constant $c$ such that $M$ computes the function sending each input of length
$n$ to the run of $C\,(n+1)^{e}$ ones, within $c\,(n+1)^{e+1}$ steps.
